properties.name: security.login-lockout.enabled
properties.description: Enable account lockout and exponential backoff after repeated failed password logins.

properties.name: security.login-lockout.max-attempts
properties.description: Consecutive failed password logins that trigger the first lockout.

properties.name: security.login-lockout.base-lock-duration
properties.description: Lock duration applied when max-attempts is first reached.

properties.name: security.login-lockout.backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Factor the lock duration is multiplied by for each additional failed login after a lock expires.

properties.name: security.login-lockout.max-lock-duration
properties.description: Upper bound for a single lock duration.

properties.name: security.login-lockout.failure-reset-window
properties.description: Failure counter is reset if no failed login occurs within this window.
